correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, actual S(K_n) bipartition signatures separate into incident selected edges at each original vertex and selected original endpoints at each subdivision vertex. The latter are distinct nonempty exactly when at most one original vertex is omitted. The former are distinct nonempty exactly when the selected-edge graph has no K1 or isolated K2 component. This gives the iff classification. Labelled connected-component exponential formula removes sizes 1 and 2, producing P_n=(n z^(n-1)+z^n)A_n. If c components all have >=3 vertices, |F|>=n-c>=ceil(2n/3), with equality iff c=floor(n/3) and each component is a tree. Cayley labelled tree counts on size 3,4,5 component profiles yield all minimizers. Separate independent enumeration of actual open-code signatures gives (n,total,min,multiplicity)=(3,16,4,9),(4,190,6,64),(5,4368,8,625). Tests corroborate but do not prove the infinite n statement.
residual_risks: n>=3 only; simple complete graph with each edge subdivided once
